name: o-json: read the generated jq and mapping

actions.label: Close the jq panel
actions.caption: q closes the jq panel and returns its space to the document. Use it when the recipe no longer needs to stay visible.

actions.label: Return focus to the document
actions.caption: esc returns focus to the structure and keeps the jq panel visible. Continue editing while watching the generated recipe.

actions.label: Switch between mapping and jq
actions.caption: tab switches from the mapping to its jq program. Compare the declarative field map with the program you can run elsewhere.

actions.label: Copy the displayed mapping
actions.caption: Y copies the whole mapping shown in this panel. Keep a reusable recipe for the structure you built.

actions.label: Find the panel keys
actions.caption: ? opens help for this read-only panel. Discover selection, copy and navigation keys in the context where they work.

actions.label: Read earlier text in the panel
actions.caption: K addresses detail scrolling. In this mapping editor, G reaches the end and k moves up through its text instead.

actions.label: Distinguish detail scrolling
actions.caption: J addresses an overflowing detail panel. This mapping is a text editor, so j moves its cursor and scrolls its window instead.

actions.label: Move to the next region
actions.caption: ) chooses the next focus region. This page has one region; esc then ctrl+a o moves into data instead. Choose pane motion when region motion stays put.

actions.label: Move to the preceding region
actions.caption: ( chooses the preceding region. This page has one region; esc then ctrl+w l focuses data explicitly. Use the pane direction when you know where to go.

actions.label: Repeat a structure put
actions.caption: esc returns to the structure; i y y p makes a copy and . repeats that put. Reuse a change at the current focus.

actions.label: Read the end of the mapping
actions.caption: G moves to the last line of the mapping. Check the final fields without scrolling one line at a time.

actions.label: Move back in the recipe
actions.caption: w w moves forward twice; b returns by a word. Revisit the preceding part of a mapping entry.

actions.label: Reach the end of a word
actions.caption: w reaches the next word; e moves to its end. Position a selection exactly on the text you want.

actions.label: Move forward in the recipe
actions.caption: w moves to the next word in the read-only mapping. Inspect a field reference more precisely before copying part of it.

actions.label: Select a block of text
actions.caption: ctrl+v starts a rectangular selection; j l extends it. Select aligned parts of several mapping lines.

actions.label: Select mapping lines
actions.caption: V selects a whole mapping line; j extends the selection. Copy complete entries without cutting through a JSON line.

actions.label: Begin a g motion
actions.caption: g begins a two-key motion in the read-only editor. The next key can choose a larger jump, such as g g to its start.

actions.label: Choose a copy register
actions.caption: " begins register selection. Type the register name next to keep a recipe separately from later copies.

actions.label: Choose a macro to replay
actions.caption: @ begins macro-register selection. Pick a recorded macro next when repeating a navigation or editing sequence.

actions.label: Visit the next page
actions.caption: ctrl+j moves to the next page, the SPLIT restructure page. Switch tasks without reopening the file.

actions.label: Choose a page by name
actions.caption: ' opens the page picker. Choose the page you need directly when several are available.

actions.label: Visit the preceding page
actions.caption: ctrl+k selects the preceding page in the page order. Walk backward through the available workspaces.

actions.label: Give a pane more width
actions.caption: ctrl+w > grows the active pane divider. Make long field paths easier to read while the jq panel stays open.

actions.label: Reset the pane divider
actions.caption: ctrl+w > changes the divider first; ctrl+w = restores its balanced position. Recover the normal layout after comparing long fields.

actions.label: Give the neighboring pane room
actions.caption: ctrl+w < shrinks the active pane divider. Rebalance the document panes without closing the recipe.

actions.label: Choose an earlier copy
actions.caption: Y copies the mapping; esc returns to the structure, then g y opens yank history. Recover a previous copy without rebuilding the selection.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
